title: finding(components,a11y): the `ui:select` form renderer's label is not associated with its combobox (no `htmlFor`, no trigger `id`), so a labelled select has an EMPTY accessible name
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site and a measurement. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the execution seat that claims it. The site is `packages/components/src/renderers/form/select.tsx`.

Filed by the `domain:ui#4` execution seat (`session_01BP8CMtACxTdLjqR6rhd33C`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#10368 (PR objectui#10428, class a). The contract review of that PR confirmed it at source. ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here.

## The defect

`ui:select` renders its `Label` with no `htmlFor`, and the Radix `SelectTrigger` with no `id`. Nothing sets `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. The trigger is a button with role `combobox`, a role that does not take its name from its content, so neither the placeholder nor the value text names it. A labelled select's combobox therefore has an EMPTY accessible name: a screen reader announces an unnamed combobox, and `getByRole('combobox', { name: LABEL })` cannot find it.

## Measured

objectui#10368's dev measured this in Chromium 141's accessibility tree (CDP `Accessibility.getFullAXTree`) on a render of `{ type: 'select', id: 'x', label: 'Title', options: [...] }`. The combobox name was `''`, both before and after objectui#10428. objectui#10428 changed only the required marker's shape. Its new span carries `aria-hidden`, so once the label is associated the name comes out clean (`Title`).

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- The fix shape exists in this repo: the `record-picker-label-association-5771` changeset. Give the trigger the schema's `id`, and give the label `htmlFor` to it.
- Pin: a labelled `ui:select` is found by `getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Title' })`, and a required one's name stays `Title`.
- It is the same class as objectui#10367 (form a11y). That card's `ScreenView` also renders a `SelectTrigger`, with an id; this card is the published `@object-ui/components` renderer.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items. The pattern select near htmlFor / accessible name / label near combobox / SelectTrigger / unassociated / empty, or `SelectTrigger` near `id` ⇒ 2 hits. One is objectui#10367 (other surfaces, bare `*` markers; ⛔ not this). The other is objectui#8507 (closed, em-dash fallbacks, unrelated). The control `accessible name` ⇒ 11 hits, among them objectui#10367 and objectui#10368, so the instrument is lit.

Dedupe words: `select renderer label not associated combobox accessible name` · `SelectRenderer Label htmlFor SelectTrigger id` · `ui:select accessible name empty`
